# glinet_led (Resource)

Turns the LEDs of the router on or off. The router has one LED configuration, so use one instance of this resource. The LED schedule (`glinet_led_schedule`) does not change this setting. Destroy removes the resource from the Terraform state and does not change the router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_led" "this" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the LEDs are on (`led_enable` in the router API).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `led`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "led".
terraform import glinet_led.this led
```
